label: Revenue growth (YoY)
short_definition: Revenue growth versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
formula_description: (Revenue[t] - Revenue[t-1]) / Revenue[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year

label: Revenue growth (3Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual revenue growth over three fiscal years.

label: EPS growth (YoY)
short_definition: Diluted EPS growth versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
formula_description: (Diluted EPS[t] - Diluted EPS[t-1]) / Diluted EPS[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year

label: EPS growth (3Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual diluted EPS growth over three fiscal years.

label: Revenue growth (5Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual revenue growth over five fiscal years.
formula_description: (Revenue[t] / Revenue[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py -- a purely additive GROWTH_METRICS entry, same mechanism as the locked 3Y CAGR.

label: Revenue growth (10Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual revenue growth over ten fiscal years.
formula_description: (Revenue[t] / Revenue[t-10]) ^ (1/10) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: EPS growth (5Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual diluted EPS growth over five fiscal years.
formula_description: (Diluted EPS[t] / Diluted EPS[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: EPS growth (10Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual diluted EPS growth over ten fiscal years.
formula_description: (Diluted EPS[t] / Diluted EPS[t-10]) ^ (1/10) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: FCF growth (3Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual free-cash-flow growth over three fiscal years.
formula_description: (FCF[t] / FCF[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, FY only. Computed in mapper/fcf_growth.py -- FCF is a computed metric_value, not a raw canonical_fact, so ttm.py's generic growth engine can't reach it directly.

label: FCF growth (5Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual free-cash-flow growth over five fiscal years.
formula_description: Same as fcf_growth_3y_cagr, 5-year lag. Computed in mapper/fcf_growth.py.

label: Net income growth (YoY)

formula_description: (Net Income[t] - Net Income[t-1]) / Net Income[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

formula_description: (Net Income[t] / Net Income[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

short_definition: Compound annual net income growth over five fiscal years.
formula_description: (Net Income[t] / Net Income[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: Net income growth (10Y CAGR)

formula_description: (Net Income[t] / Net Income[t-10]) ^ (1/10) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: FCF growth (YoY)
short_definition: Change in free cash flow versus the same fiscal year one year earlier.
formula_description: (FCF[t] - FCF[t-1]) / FCF[t-1], FY only. Computed in mapper/fcf_growth.py -- same reasoning as fcf_growth_3y_cagr/5y_cagr (FCF is a computed metric_value, not a raw canonical_fact).
